lesson-intro.text: Before battle, every knight painted their shield in their own colors. This one is split into four quarters with a rim of rivets. Watch it get painted, then design a shield of your own.

outline.text: The shield has a flat top and a point at the bottom. From the middle of the top, draw each half.

rim.text: A second outline runs just inside the first, the same shape. The band between them is the rim.

boss.text: In the middle of the shield sits a round boss.

quarters.text: Two lines cross behind the boss, one down and one across, cutting four quarters.

rivets-1.text: Small round rivets stud the rim. Three along the top, three down the left side.

rivets-2.text: Three more down the right side and one at the point, ten in all.

quarters-color.text: Two quarters are blue and two are red, matching across the corners.

gold.text: Gold for the boss and all ten rivets.

lesson-outro.text: Your shield is ready for battle. Which colors would you paint on yours?
